kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انسحقت (form VII)
# اِنْسَحَقْتُ (insaḥaqtu) /in.sa.ħaq.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# اِنْسَحَقْتَ (insaḥaqta) /in.sa.ħaq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# اِنْسَحَقْتِ (insaḥaqti) /in.sa.ħaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# اِنْسَحَقَتْ (insaḥaqat) /in.sa.ħa.qat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
